glossEn: relating to human society and its members
note: relating to human society and its members。社会制度、与人 society 相关的。

glossEn: living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups
note: living together in communities or organized groups。群体生活方式，蚂蚁蜜蜂典型。

glossEn: relating to or belonging to or characteristic of high society
note: characteristic of high society。上流社会的、交际界的。

glossEn: composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability
note: composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability。为社交目的组织的、爱交际的。

glossZh: 群居习性的（同类成群而居）
glossEn: tending to move or live together in groups or colonies of the same kind
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] WORDNET 补缺 tending to move or live together in groups or colonies of the same kind。与 s2 的差别：s2 说群体生活方式本身，本条说个体有群居倾向（同类成群）。

glossEn: marked by friendly companionship with others
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] WORDNET 补缺 marked by friendly companionship with others。强调人际友善，与 s3「上流的」区分：s3 是阶层，本条是态度。
